plan.title: Service PR to PO with Technical and RFQ Award

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule before inviting vendors.

args.goal: on the buyer create screen, set the evaluation duration to 30 minutes, add one required Terms and Conditions clause, save both changes, and stop when the create screen shows the saved schedule and clause

steps.note: Handle the required evaluation-duration setting and single required T&C clause, which have no dedicated catalog steps.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors without inventing supplier names.
Publish the configured Technical plus RFQ event.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Have the first invited vendor answer the technical stage and submit a quote of 100 per activity.
Verify that the first vendor's submission was accepted.
Have the second invited vendor answer the technical stage and submit a quote of 90 per activity.
Verify that the second vendor's submission was accepted.
Close the bidding window so evaluation and awarding can proceed.
Score and submit the technical responses after the technical stage closes.
Open the buyer comparison grid after both vendors have bid.
Verify that the lower RFQ amount ranks first, establishing Vendor B as L1.
Award the full event to the lowest-ranked vendor.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.remark: Approved for service PR award to the lowest bidder.

steps.note: Approve the submitted proposal with the required approver remark.
Complete approval and create the purchase order(s) from the award.
Verify that the resulting PO data carries both PR activity lines with quantities.
Open the events list to verify the completed event moved to history.
Switch to the History tab.
Verify that this plan's event appears in event history.
